description: Commenced commercial business operations by introducing cash capital ₹6,00,000 and office furniture ₹50,000
narration: Being cash and furniture brought in by proprietor as initial business capital
explanation: Compound entry debiting Cash Asset ₹6,00,000 and Furniture Asset ₹50,000 while crediting Capital Liability ₹6,50,000.

description: Purchased trading inventory goods on credit from vendor Apex Electronics India Ltd ₹1,20,000
narration: Being inventory goods purchased on credit as per Invoice #AE-902
explanation: Increases Purchase Expense (Debit Purchases A/c ₹1,20,000) and creates Sundry Creditor Liability (Credit Apex Electronics A/c ₹1,20,000).

description: Sold inventory goods on credit to customer Sharma Traders ₹95,000
narration: Being goods sold on credit as per Sales Bill #SB-001
explanation: Creates Sundry Debtor Asset (Debit Sharma Traders A/c ₹95,000) and increases Sales Revenue (Credit Sales A/c ₹95,000).

description: Returned defective inventory goods worth ₹15,000 to Apex Electronics India Ltd under Debit Note #DN-101
narration: Being defective goods returned to vendor against Debit Note #DN-101
explanation: Reduces vendor trade liability: Debit Sundry Creditor ₹15,000, Credit Return Outward Account ₹15,000.

description: Received customer Debit Note return for damaged goods worth ₹10,000 from Sharma Traders and issued Credit Note #CN-201
narration: Being damaged goods returned by customer against Credit Note #CN-201
explanation: Reduces customer trade asset: Debit Return Inward Account ₹10,000, Credit Sundry Debtor ₹10,000.

description: Paid monthly shop rent ₹20,000 and office electricity bill ₹6,000 by SBI Bank cheque #501902
narration: Being shop rent and electricity charges paid via SBI Bank cheque #501902
explanation: Compound payment debiting Rent Expense ₹20,000 and Electricity Expense ₹6,000 while crediting SBI Bank Asset ₹26,000.

description: Received cheque of ₹80,000 from Sharma Traders and allowed cash discount ₹5,000 in full settlement of ₹85,000 debt
narration: Being cheque received from debtor and cash discount allowed in full settlement
explanation: Compound receipt debiting Bank Asset ₹80,000 and Discount Allowed Expense ₹5,000 while crediting Debtor Asset ₹85,000.

description: Proprietor withdrew cash ₹15,000 for daughter's school fee payment
narration: Being cash withdrawn by proprietor for personal household educational expenses
explanation: Personal withdrawal: Debit Drawings Account ₹15,000 (reducing Owner Capital) and Credit Cash Asset ₹15,000.

description: Paid staff salary ₹35,000 in cash for April 2026
narration: Being staff salary for April paid in cash
explanation: Routine operating expense: Debit Salary Expense Account ₹35,000, Credit Cash Asset ₹35,000.

description: Charged annual 10% depreciation on office furniture worth ₹50,000 at year end
narration: Being 10% annual depreciation charged on office furniture asset
explanation: Non-cash adjusting entry: Debit Depreciation Expense Account ₹5,000, Credit Furniture Asset ₹5,000.
